adr_reviews.review: The missing branch ADR 1235 identified was the no-/F named page in the associated PDF, converted into a Form XObject and placed as the field appearance. Current code does this. Its page-to-form geometry/resource claims are implemented, but existing APRef tests do not independently assert the generated geometry.

The second-file hop is current behavior. Table253 /F holds an awaited page; a host supplies the file and the page is copied into the target appearance. Existing model tests check visible text change; viewer-core tests check host request/report. Do not repeat the historical claim that the external branch is still unbuilt.

Subsequent work consolidates file supply, password retry and arrival handling for named-page requests. It changes the host workflow, not page_as_form geometry; no new APRef-specific raster assertion found.

Copying direct resources/streams when the reference comes from an external file prevents target AP resources from referring into the source Document. The same-document branch retains references into the same document. Existing second-file content test is a useful resource-copy control but uses direct source page Resources and checks extracted text only.
Producer provenance underlies not composing source /Annots into a form. Current implementation reports annotation count instead. The bounded audit did not reconsider that scope decision.

decisions.question: Does current evidence show that APRef branches are absent?
decisions.answer: No. Same-file page resolution, AP precedence, widget appearance delivery and save/reopen text are implemented. The external file question and supply path are also implemented through viewer-core and host policy.

decisions.question: Is a page-to-form geometry regression warranted?
decisions.answer: Yes, narrowly. page_as_form computes CropBox BBox, Rotate Matrix and inherited Resources, but current APRef tests only observe text and no unit test exercises page_as_form's output. Generic annotations raster tests already cover the downstream §12.5.5 matrix algorithm, so a test should specifically discriminate page-to-form conversion via a rotated named page, inherited resource and saved/reopened appearance.

decisions.question: Are sample pixel values source-mandated?
decisions.answer: The source requires clockwise page rotation and appearance mapping to Rect, but pixel rasterization is the consumer oracle. Use solid cell interiors and relational placement to avoid antialias or filter ambiguity; don't certify the entire transform algorithm from this one fixture.

decisions.question: Does this establish page Group handling?
decisions.answer: The revised unexecuted draft adds a separate serialized-output assertion that the source page's /Group (/S /Transparency, /CS /DeviceRGB, /I true) is carried onto the generated normal appearance stream. This establishes structural transfer only. Generic appearance-group tests exercise downstream compositing semantics; this draft does not claim an APRef-specific pixel test of group semantics.
